overview: The committee reviewed updated project cost estimates and approved the submission of the Preliminary Design Program (PDP) report to the MSBA. Members also extensively debated and amended the evaluation criteria matrix that will be used to narrow down the 29 school design options.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the previous session.

items.title: Comparative Cost Estimates Update
items.summary: Reviewed revised cost estimates featuring reductions of $30 to $44 million across several alternatives following the correction of square footage double-counting in the Early Childhood Center and pool programs.

items.title: Preliminary Design Program (PDP) Submission
items.summary: Approved the submission of the PDP report to the Massachusetts School Building Authority (MSBA) following a discussion on distilling the 2,400-page document into accessible highlights for the public.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria: Space Optimization and Education
items.summary: Amended the matrix to evaluate 'optimally sized classroom spaces' rather than 'adequately sized spaces'; motions to strike criteria regarding the educational plan and future-ready building adaptability failed.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria: Sustainability and Maintenance
items.summary: Approved splitting maintenance evaluation into separate categories for 'ease of maintenance' and 'magnitude of maintenance costs' while adding a criterion for 'responsible stewardship of the natural environment.'

items.title: Evaluation Criteria: Site and Community Access
items.summary: Added new evaluative criteria for on-site traffic circulation, community access to CTE program services, the Early Childhood Center, and the Welcome Center; the committee also split athletic access into distinct categories for the pool, gym, and fitness areas.

items.title: Evaluation Matrix Next Steps
items.summary: Approved a motion for the project team to provide a detailed comparison explainer and a completed draft evaluation matrix for committee review at the next meeting.

items.title: Upcoming Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Reviewed dates for upcoming deliberations on construction delivery methods, community forums, and the selection of preferred design options through June.
